no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee Meeting was held for this Application.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for the original CHOLBAM NDA205750 application. The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review and Medical Review both state no AC meeting was held, and the review documents explain that an advisory committee was not convened because outside expertise was not deemed necessary to address the efficacy and safety questions; instead three Center-level briefings were held (September 11, November 3, and December 9, 2014). With no AdComm, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
